name: Chris Gofton
source:
The leader of Requiem, a rival raiding guild, Chris has a reputation of being a hot-tempered, blunt jerk with a sharp-tongue. 
Only a lucky few have been able to get through the tough demeanor to their secret, soft side that they try very hard to hide. 
When even their own guide turns its back on them, will you stay by their side? 

[From [url=https://wind-chimes-games.itch.io/emberfate]itch.io[/url]]
